craft_notes: FIRST-VERSE VOICE (verdict outstanding — same hand proposed for the whole song-set). Sthāyin: catalogue-joy braced by resolve (adbhuta + vīra-utsāha). Sanskrit first: two balanced list-pādas sealed by eva/ca → L4 keeps all eight members uncut across the break, dash holds the first five, second line lands wheel-rest plus the bridging ca. Rows: row 2 fired (catalogue never split mid-member); row 1 (predicate-last mirrored — 'proceeds' closes as ca closes the pāda); rows 6-7 silent (no vocative, no refrain to invent). Rupture: dash after the noun-trio — naming held, members released. Close: forward lean, no colon (the list opens outward). Minimal pass: 'each sealed' trimmed to 'sealed'; zero diction change otherwise. Read aloud: line 1 counts on four beats, dash breath, line 2 lifts and walks on. Rejected: carrying L3 verbatim — killed: L4 must lean forward where Sanskrit bridges (ca); Latinate 'portal/visage' — killed: plain bluntness keeps the teacher's voice; exclamation — killed: shouting un-Sanskrit.

lines: Place, entry, form — mark and sign, sealed indeed,
raising, awakening, wheel-rest — and the count proceeds.
